name: 绿草精灵
evolution: 绿草精灵 → 魔草巫灵 Lv.32
description: 在森林里挥舞着手中的木棍，好像是在做施放巫术的练习。偶尔会和帽子交谈，晒太阳的时候可能会发出诡异的笑声。
descriptionEn: Waving a wooden stick in the forest, as if practicing casting spells. Occasionally talks to its hat, and may let out eerie laughter while sunbathing.

skills.name: 汲取
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage and drains 100% HP.

skills.name: 花香
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 移花接木
skills.description: 自己回复15%生命，随后脱离。

skills.name: 酶浓度调整
skills.description: 减伤80%，应对攻击：自己回复20%生命。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 80%; when responding to attacks: recovers 20% HP.

skills.name: 棘突
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 富养化
skills.description: 为场下每个精灵回复3能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Recovers 3 energy for each benched spirit.

skills.name: 心灵洞悉
skills.description: 敌方获得星陨印记，获得层数等于敌方印记层数。
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy gains Starfall marks equal to enemy's current mark count.

skills.name: 坍缩
skills.description: 造成魔伤，若击败敌方，自己获得魔攻+70%。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; if enemy is defeated, gains Magic Attack +70%.

skills.name: 盛开
skills.description: 自己获得全技能威力+30，应对防御：改为威力+60。
skills.descriptionEn: Gains all-skill power +30; when responding to defense: becomes power +60.
